body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. You may burn 1 die after rolling to gain 1 free Surge on this Action.

surges.html: If the target has any Condition, this Action ignores 1 Defense.
On a success, the target burns 1 die.

rider.title: GAMBIT CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: You fail an Action against the target. Effect: Your next Action against it before your next turn may commit 1 fewer die, minimum 2.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
